extDescription: Ask AI about the page you're reading: summaries, explanations and translations without leaving Safari.
emptyTitle: What would you like to know?
emptyPage: I can see this page. Ask a question or pick an action.
emptySelection: Ask about the selected text or pick an action.
emptyNone: This page can't be read, but you can ask me anything.
promptSummarize: Summarize this page in 5–7 bullet points, then give the main conclusion in one sentence.
promptKeyPoints: What are the key takeaways from this page? List the important facts, numbers and dates.
promptExplain: Explain this page in simple words, as if to a smart 12-year-old.
promptTranslate: Translate the main content of this page into {0}. Keep the structure and headings.
promptSelExplain: Explain the selected text in simple words.
promptSelImprove: Rewrite the selected text to be clearer and more concise. Give one improved version.
promptReply: Draft a short, polite reply to this message or post.
errNetwork: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errBusy: ContextFlow is very busy right now. Please try again in a minute.
errUpstream: The AI service didn't respond. Please try again.
errBadKey: OpenAI rejected your API key. Check it in Settings.
errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
limitFreeBody: New free answers in {0}. Pro gives you up to {1} answers a week.
usagePro: Pro · {0} of {1} answers left this week
consentBody: To answer, ContextFlow sends your question and the text of this page (or your selection) to OpenAI via our server. Page content and chats are not stored on our servers; your chats stay on this device.
setFabHint: Auto shows the button on iPhone and iPad. On Mac use the toolbar icon or Ctrl+Shift+E.
setAboutHint: Optional. Helps tailor answers, e.g. “I'm a product designer, keep it short”.
setOwnKeyHint: Included in Pro and Own key plans. Paste an OpenAI or Anthropic (Claude) key; requests go straight from your device to that provider.
setOwnKeyLocked: Available with Pro or Own key plan
setOwnKeyModelHint: Fast: newest Claude Haiku or GPT mini. Smart: newest Claude Sonnet or GPT.
welcomeBody: Open any website and tap the ✦ button or the ContextFlow icon in the toolbar. Select text to ask about just that part.
welcomeRestricted: Safari doesn't let extensions read this page. Open a regular website to use ContextFlow.
welcomePermission: If nothing happens, allow ContextFlow on all websites: Safari → Extensions → ContextFlow → All Websites → Allow.
